book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Kule suŋgo prona
Kile Suŋgo nu Noa sana: Ye taŋgo pino ŋakmba kaŋgerket ta nane ŋgamukŋge neŋge ndo maŋau purfeŋnu ŋak minit le ye ne kagmanet. Ta tuku kile ne naŋe gageu turmba waŋ ta poŋgap ŋgina.
Agaŋmor nyam tuku atraukam tuku ta ar ar pailnu 7 paŋgarnu 7 kilmba waŋ mbolŋge patika. Agaŋmor tane pintiŋgen ta armba ndo pailnu paŋgarnu kila.
Sar umaŋ ar ar pailnu 7 paŋgarnu 7 kila. Agaŋ ŋakmba tumunu minam tuku kila.
Kusem ndindo te kugawa le ye saki le sawe suŋgokanu ki 40 furir 40 piymba minamŋgat. Sawe ta mbolŋge ye agaŋ wakeiken le abo minig ta ŋakmba ma gureŋmba kile-ŋgisike suluwamŋgit ŋgina.
Suŋgo nu Noa wam paguna ta Noa nu miŋge kumumba taŋamba ndo kina.
Noa nu yar 600 ŋak minna le kule suŋgo ta promba kilke soŋgina.
Noa, kiŋo kat nuŋe, piyo nuŋe, rugan kat nuŋe nane kule prowamŋgat ŋga waŋ poŋginaig.
Sar umaŋ agaŋmor nyam tuku pinkam tuku
ar ar pailnu paŋgarnu nane Kuate nu Noa wam paguna ta kumumba Noa ndoŋ waŋ poŋginaig.
Waŋ poŋginaig le kusem ndindo kugana le kule suŋgo ta kilke mbol prona.
Noa tuku yar 600 tambun arnu ait 17 ait ta mbolŋge kilke puluke lika kule sugokanu bulbulmba kilke mbolŋge prowe likinaig. Samba mata puluka sawe suŋgokanu piyna.
Ki 40 furir 40 sawe ta pur ndamba piymba minna.
Ki ait ndui ta mbolŋge Noa nuŋe piyo nuŋe kiŋo kat nuŋe Sem Ham Yafet nuŋe rugan kat nuŋe keŋmba ndoŋ nane waŋ poŋginaig.
Sar umaŋ agaŋmor tumbraŋok ŋguikok nane yeki yeki ar ar ŋakmba Noa nane ndoŋ waŋ poŋginaig.
Kilke mbol agaŋ nyu mindek pailnu paŋgarnu Kuate buk sana ta kumumba waŋ poŋginaig. Taŋanaig le Suŋgoŋge malaŋga tukulna.
Sawe ta mara 40 piymba minna le kule ta nzomba waŋ te-faitna.
Taŋamba kule nzomba mbolka waŋ te-faitna le kule mbol mbol lika minna.
Kule suŋgo ŋayomba tabe sugo funu basleniŋmba biŋ ŋakmba kile-butokina.
Kile-butokina sulumba maŋ kule mbolke ŋayomba mita 7 mbolŋge kumuŋgina.
Sar umaŋ agaŋmor tumbraŋok ŋguikok agaŋ ŋakmba kilke mbolŋge likinaig tuku taŋgo pino ŋakmba turmba butoka ŋgisike sulunaig.
Agaŋ nyunu mindek kilke mbolŋge mabseŋ ŋak ta ŋakmba kume sulunaig.
Suŋgoŋge kilke mbol mbal ŋakmba ma gureŋmba kile-ŋgisike suluna. Taŋgo pino sar umaŋ agaŋmor tumbraŋok ŋguikok agaŋ afu mine ndakinaig. Noa nane ndo waŋ sinam taŋge abo minnaig.
Kule ta tambun 5 mara 150 taŋamba kilke mbolŋge ibeŋ ndaka suŋgokanu minna.
